purpose: Convert current GitHub research into concrete GLM enhancements without vendoring frameworks.

enhancements.name: Durable mission state
enhancements.benefit: Resume long missions after approval, worker failure, or restart.

enhancements.name: Approval interrupts
enhancements.benefit: Pause risky missions with a persisted decision envelope and resume.

enhancements.name: Agent eval harness
enhancements.benefit: Synthetic regression suite for specialist behavior.
enhancements.guard: evaluation data isolated from production stores.

enhancements.name: Session/context/artifact contracts
enhancements.benefit: Keep mission context and artifacts explicit instead of hidden global state.

enhancements.name: Browser capability profile
enhancements.benefit: Allowlisted browser actions with isolated profiles and evidence capture.

enhancements.name: Adaptive crawl research
enhancements.benefit: Better source discovery with caching, structured extraction and resumable crawl state.
enhancements.guard: all web content treated as untrusted data.

enhancements.name: Durable job envelope
enhancements.benefit: Idempotent retries, concurrency keys, checkpoints and resumability.
enhancements.guard: lab first; canonical writer remains outside worker.

enhancements.name: GitHub least-privilege profile
enhancements.benefit: Tool allowlists and read-only mode for research workers.

enhancements.name: Agent/skill packs
enhancements.benefit: Versioned role manifests, instructions, TDD and verification gates.
enhancements.guard: third-party skill content is reviewed before adoption.

enhancements.name: Evidence-first research bundles
enhancements.benefit: Research outputs carry source plan, claim provenance and stop conditions.
enhancements.guard: research is advisory; no direct writes.
